name: com.mcpqueen/registry
title: MCP Queen
description: The evidence layer for MCP: live operational grades plus Trust Receipts for every registry server.

com.mcpqueen/differentiators.what: Evidence layer over the official MCP registry — verifies operational behavior, advertised claims, response quality, and real-world use rather than merely listing servers
com.mcpqueen/differentiators.method: Live streamable-HTTP operational probes are kept separate from Trust Receipts. Safe read-only response audits measure usable calls and semantic failures, then resolve returned PMID/DOI identifiers against authoritative sources. Every observation is dated and sourced; missing evidence is unaudited, never a pass.
com.mcpqueen/differentiators.integrity: No stars, votes, pay-to-rank, or synthetic trust score. Agent field reports are quarantined for human review and never affect operational grades.
com.mcpqueen/differentiators.badges: https://mcpqueen.com/badge/{registry-name}.svg — live operational grade only; not a security or data-quality certification
